findings.title: Terminal absorbing invariant does not explicitly reject same-identity re-prepare
basis: Explore states that terminal is absorbing for the same current Action.
Explore describes terminal replacement as terminal A -> prepare another/new canonical identity B.
The transition matrix only says terminal A + prepare canonical B is allowed and does not state B != A.
Proof D tests terminal A -> prepare B, terminal -> resume rejection, terminal -> terminal rejection, and unknown action rejection, but does not test terminal A -> prepare A.
A literal implementation of the written matrix accepts terminal A -> prepare A and reopens the terminal semantic identity as prepared.
findings.impact: Proposal could encode a transition that contradicts the stated terminal absorbing invariant and weakens the duplicate/terminal boundary before Run occurrence identity exists.
requiredRevision: State explicitly that terminal A -> prepare A MUST reject.
Define terminal replacement as allowed only when the new canonical semantic ActionIdentity is different from the current terminal identity.
Add the negative controlled-proof case terminal A -> prepare A reject.
Keep RunId/attempt identity out of this Change; this correction does not require introducing occurrence identity.
